reports.title: Help help help.
reports.explanation: Critical thermal and pressure anomaly flagged in Boiler Room A. Immediate emergency isolation protocol initiated under OSHA 1910.
recommendations: Execute thermal isolation and verify emergency steam pressure relief venting.
Deploy certified boiler technician in Level B thermal PPE to inspect safety relief valves.
Establish a 50-meter safety cordon and log shift incident report in compliance with OSHA 1910.261.

reports.title: Loose scaffolding planks at Unit 3
reports.description: Worker observed third-floor scaffolding platform missing middle guardrail and multiple wooden planks are unsecured
reports.explanation: High fall risk identified on Unit 3 third-floor scaffolding platform. Precursor analysis mandates immediate red-tagging per OSHA 1926.451.
recommendations: Red-tag scaffold as 'DO NOT USE' until re-inspected by certified competent person under OSHA 1926.451.
Fasten all wooden planks with steel cleats and install 4-inch toe boards along work platform.
Verify structural tie-ins to permanent walls and install full diagonal cross-bracing.

reports.title: Corroded flange line steam leak
reports.description: High pressure steam leak observed on flange line TK-80. Fire and burn risk.
reports.explanation: High pressure steam leak on TK-80 presents immediate thermal and burn hazard. Depressurization and gasket replacement required.
recommendations: Depressurize line TK-80 and verify 0 PSI reading on calibrated gauges before opening couplings.
Deploy certified pipefitter crew in thermal protective gear to replace corroded spiral-wound gasket.
Torque flange bolts to 185 ft-lbs in star sequence and conduct ultrasonic steam leak audit.

reports.title: TK-80 Scaffolding – Missing handrail & perimeter barrier
reports.description: Frontline walkdown noticed 3 meters of perimeter kickboards and outer handrail absent on Tier 3 scaffolding. High fall hazard (SIF Precursor).
reports.explanation: Missing 3-meter guardrail section on Tier 3 scaffolding constitutes an active SIF precursor under OSHA 1926.451.
recommendations: Issue immediate Stop-Work notice on Tier 3 until full-body harness 100% tie-off compliance is enforced.
Install OSHA-compliant 42-inch top-rail, 21-inch mid-rail, and 4-inch toe-boards along Tier 3.
Conduct daily competent-person scaffolding structural re-certification before shift commencement.

reports.title: V-204 Hydrocracker – Radial vibration anomaly on bearing
reports.description: AI vibration telemetry flagged 4.8 mm/s radial spike on feed pump bearing housing.
precursors: Rotating Parts and Nip Point Exposure
reports.explanation: Radial vibration of 4.8 mm/s on V-204 feed pump bearing indicates rapid mechanical degradation approaching ISO 10816 alarm limit.
recommendations: Perform high-resolution FFT vibration spectral analysis to identify inner raceway bearing fatigue.
Drain and flush contaminated bearing lubricant reservoir, checking for metal particulate wear.
Replace worn spherical roller bearing assembly and verify dynamic shaft alignment within 0.05 mm.

reports.title: EX-12 Flange Line – Minor oily condensation on lower joint
reports.description: Worker walkdown observed slight weeping and oily condensation on lower flange joint.
reports.explanation: Minor hydrocarbon seepage on EX-12 flange joint warrants containment and retorque to prevent seal blow-out.
recommendations: Install secondary chemical drip containment pan beneath EX-12 lower flange joint.
Perform calibrated torque wrench verification on flange studs to OEM 145 ft-lbs specification.
Conduct ultrasonic wall thickness measurement and VOC sniff test to confirm joint integrity.

alerts.reportTitle: Stair is broken in maintenance room
alerts.message: HIGH SIF HAZARD: Stair is broken in maintenance room at Maintenance Workshop
recommendations: Deploy portable high-output LED work lights to restore safe illumination levels immediately.
Remove damaged ladder from service and destroy or tag out immediately.
Replace blown fluorescent/LED tubes in stairwells and primary access pathways.
